event.name: 2013 April 11 near-Earth proton event
event.coordinate_authority: Carrington/HGR values at the event epoch; transform into the declared srcSEP3D Cartesian frame before constructing an input deck

published_parameters.name: cme_speed_m_per_s
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: swcme.cme.launch_speed

published_parameters.name: cme_carrington_longitude_deg
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: transform with cme_carrington_latitude_deg into swcme.geometry.cme_direction_[xyz]

published_parameters.name: cme_carrington_latitude_deg
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: transform with cme_carrington_longitude_deg into swcme.geometry.cme_direction_[xyz]

published_parameters.name: earth_carrington_longitude_deg
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: transform with Earth latitude and radius into observer Cartesian position

published_parameters.name: earth_carrington_latitude_deg
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: transform with Earth longitude and radius into observer Cartesian position

published_parameters.name: earth_radius_m
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: observer position radius and domain outer radius

published_parameters.name: pre_event_earth_wind_speed_m_per_s
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: background.parker.solar_wind_speed_m_per_s and swcme.ambient.wind_speed

published_parameters.name: nominal_photospheric_footpoint_carrington_longitude_deg
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: connectivity cross-check only; do not copy directly to the 20-R_sun resolved Parker start

published_parameters.name: resolved_20_rsun_parker_start_longitude_deg
published_parameters.source: reference derivation from liu-2025-table-2, Omega=2.865e-6 rad/s, and the exact source-surface-corrected srcSEP3D Parker equation
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: documented reference only; prepare_case.py recomputes mesh.tube.source_longitude_rad from the reviewed Earth longitude, fitted rotation rate, and wind speed

published_parameters.name: mean_free_path_reference_m
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: transport.mean_free_path_reference_m

published_parameters.name: mean_free_path_reference_radius_m
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: transport.mean_free_path_reference_radius_m

published_parameters.name: mean_free_path_reference_rigidity_v
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: transport.mean_free_path_reference_rigidity_v

published_parameters.name: mean_free_path_radial_exponent
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: transport.mean_free_path_radial_exponent

published_parameters.name: mean_free_path_rigidity_exponent
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: transport.mean_free_path_rigidity_exponent

published_parameters.name: seed_injection_energy_j
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: source.minimum_energy_j

published_parameters.name: seed_momentum_power_law_index
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: source.spectrum_model=fixed-phase-space-power-law and source.phase_space_power_index=5; the input stores positive q in f(p) proportional to p^(-q)

published_parameters.name: seed_injection_coefficient
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: publication phase-space-density normalization metadata; not interchangeable with source.injection_efficiency or a number rate

published_parameters.name: published_flux_scale
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: comparison-level amplitude metadata only; never assign to the probability-valued source.injection_efficiency

published_parameters.name: earth_cobpoint_compression_ratio_at_24_min
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: diagnostic target for the local Earth-connected shock flank, not a direct SWCME input

published_parameters.name: earth_cobpoint_theta_bn_deg_at_24_min
published_parameters.srcsep3d_mapping: diagnostic target; the current spherical SWCME surrogate does not accept theta_Bn as an input

unresolved_inputs.name: coordinate_transform
unresolved_inputs.required_action: freeze a documented Carrington-to-model-frame transform at 2013-04-11T07:24:00Z and record the resulting Cartesian vectors

unresolved_inputs.name: ambient_density_temperature_field_and_polarity
unresolved_inputs.required_action: derive from quality-screened pre-event OMNI data over the declared averaging interval; do not use an example-deck default

unresolved_inputs.name: dbm_drag_and_shock_arrival
unresolved_inputs.required_action: fit cme.drag_coefficient against an independently selected shock/ICME arrival marker and keep that marker out of the SEP score

unresolved_inputs.name: spherical_swcme_widths_and_smoothing
unresolved_inputs.required_action: calibrate sheath/ejecta thickness and numerical smoothing to the in-situ plasma/MAG time series; the cited MHD study does not determine these surrogate parameters

unresolved_inputs.name: source_rate_and_macroparticle_weight
unresolved_inputs.required_action: choose from a particle-count convergence study, then allow only the registry's one-global-amplitude observation normalization

unresolved_inputs.name: active_corridor_radius
unresolved_inputs.required_action: increase radius and block halo until all registered observables are insensitive within the XM3D05 convergence tolerance

unresolved_inputs.name: seed_boundary_rate_mapping
unresolved_inputs.required_action: define and validate a boundary-flux or source-volume operator that maps the published Equation-21 phase-space density to srcSEP3D's physical_particle_rate_per_s; do not infer a rate from density and temperature alone

observations.data_source: SOHO_ERNE-HED_L2-1MIN and SOHO_ERNE-LED_L2-1MIN as channel coverage requires
CDAWeb/NOAA products with native quality flags and published GOES effective-energy calibration
mission science products used by the cited event studies
